fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on Miami police scandals and oversight, including arrests connected to gambling and alleged leaks from a grand juror to the police. Includes political columns on Florida factions and upcoming primaries, discussion of Coral Gables Corporation refinancing, and local notes on Prohibition-era liquor trade and Al Capone’s visit. Reports on violent conflict involving religious factions, coverage of a Miami beauty contest and the Dade County Fair, along with letters to the editor, legal notices, advertisements, and candidate announcements.
